decisions.reason: Locates the patch declaration (cordis.patch.yml:5-6), the real patch surface targeting src/session/view/SessionView.ts (patch.yml:2-6), and the DSH_HARNESS_SOURCE_ROOT-driven apply script; correctly separates profile composition from source patching and ties the session-view target to A1-03 with pending tag validation.

Locates the producer/consumer pair and ignorable:true at src/index.ts:15-22; explains the alpha.1 removal vs alpha.2 restoration as a corridor fold to the restored net state (A2-01), keeps the informational marker rather than dropping it, and explicitly notes public Session.append has no ignorable parameter instead of claiming it supports the marker.

Locates both ctx.get('apiProxy') call sites (src/index.ts:25-32) and the A1-01 removal; correctly applies the plane rule — host-plane consumers inject the domain service (ctx.llm.listProviders()) while ctx.remote is the client face — and warns against rewriting host code to a nonexistent Host remote service.

Locates the fixed homedir()/.dsh/profiles/default literal (src/index.ts:36-37), maps it to A1-04, and prescribes runtime DSH_HOME/profile resolution; it never claims --profile was introduced in alpha.1.

Locates both the @deepseek-ai/dsh-session-view/internal import (src/index.ts:10) and the registerCommand('legacy.openView') registration (41-43); maps both to the A1-03 split and requires verification against a public owning seam or exact-tag per-file checks rather than guessing new paths.

Locates the private loopback server (createServer/listen 43121, src/index.ts:4,47-54) including its dead-code status; correctly states loopback is not an auth exemption, that raw ctx.webServer routes inherit no gate/fence/CORS, and maps to A1-08 with the requestRejection/Connection-owned carrier alternative.

Locates both dsh subprocess calls with per-line JSON.parse of stdout (src/index.ts:59-65, apply-patch.mjs); explains stdout is the final assistant text while stderr carries reasoning/errors and the exit code is authoritative, treats the JSONL expectation as the wrapper's own wrong assumption per A1-05, and invents no alpha.2 stdout change.

Every located coupling is mapped to the sealed cards: patch and UI to A1-03, events folded to A2-01 net of A1-02, apiProxy to A1-01, hardcoded profile path to A1-04, loopback channel to A1-08, and the JSONL wrapper additionally to A1-05; each mapping is grounded in a cited fixture line, and extra cards are only ruled-out/context annotations, not a bare list.

Accounts for all seven categories as hits (correctly noting there are no no-hit categories), explains why absence of further matches does not prove compatibility, states static-copy scan limits, and proposes target-version typecheck/build, isolated profile boot/config dump, and a real functional flow — all on the migrated plugin, never requiring execution of this static fixture.
